import.policy: verbatim import; narrow, story-documented deviations listed under 'deviations' — shipped 4.8.1 binaries outrank the published snapshot when they measurably disagree (PROJECT.md authority order)
import.verification: Files not named under 'deviations' must match upstream.sourceTree; deviating files are accounted for individually.

deviations.reason: request-cookie configured defaults; shipped 4.8.1 (System.Web 4.8.9319.0) carries a servicing fix absent from every published source branch, ported from IL readings

backmerged from upstream branch NetFramework48ZDP (e47d8c1b6482e0babe243dff2f9ece1507c814ff): SameSiteMode ConvertTo fix and cookieSameSite doc-comment corrections; the branch's comment-scrubber hunk in Util/AppSettings.cs was deliberately not taken
Dynamic Data enablement guarded behind a resolvable-type probe; System.Web.DynamicData is not carried (ledger P69)
case-folding the configuration system's mapped directory and composed web.config name on a case-sensitive filesystem (ledger P70)
the typed WebServices getter would recreate Framework's System.Web <-> System.Web.Services assembly cycle; it returns ConfigurationSection here (ADR-0009 amendment)
WorkItem.Post refused every non-Win32NT platform, a Win9x-era guard; the post lands on the ordinary thread pool, so the guard is fenced NETFRAMEWORK for one-way web methods off Windows

SetConfigurationFilePaths seam (fenced !NETFRAMEWORK): the host publishes the machine/root config locations at bootstrap; the Framework fallback resolves against MsCorLibDirectory, which has no Config subdirectory on modern .NET, breaking consumers such as the WSDL help page path

the deserialization ctor chains to ClaimsPrincipal(SerializationInfo, StreamingContext), a throwing stub on modern .NET (SYSLIB0051); the base call is fenced NETFRAMEWORK and a payload guard refuses anything but a role-cookie ticket

AddIdentityAttachingRoles builds a DeferredRoleClaimsIdentity (fenced !NETFRAMEWORK) because ClaimsIdentity.ExternalClaims holds List<Claim> on modern .NET where Framework held IEnumerable<Claim>, so role claims cannot be parked unevaluated on a stock ClaimsIdentity

static responses opt out of server caching (fenced !NETFRAMEWORK): IIS served them from its native module before any managed module could store one, so replaying them through the registered OutputCacheModule would defeat the revalidation the handler sets

the module collection is built from the merged system.webServer/modules snapshot through the integrated-mode builder already present here, with per-request managedHandler conditioning wrapped around the classic execution steps (fenced !NETFRAMEWORK); GetHandlerMapping widened to internal so the seam reuses the cached classic mapping instead of duplicating it, and the classic UrlMappingsExecutionStep retired in favour of the golden's UrlMappingsModule row

the golden registers this module in every application, so the anonymous WindowsIdentity/WindowsPrincipal statics move into a nested holder that defers their platform failure, and IsEnabled answers false (fenced !NETFRAMEWORK) rather than the authentication section's default, which is Windows
